name_or_item: RDG Long Term Passenger Rolling Stock Strategy, new EMU
scope: total maintenance costs; capital lease, energy and track separate
source_ref: RDG, LTPRSS 3rd edition (February 2015, February 2013 price level), Table 5; https://www.raildeliverygroup.com/publications/archive/367-2015-03-long-term-passenger-rolling-stock-strategy-3rd-ed/file.html
notes: MEASURED. Table 5 prints 'Maintenance Cost GBP 0.44'. Source note: 'TOC and ROSCO sources, for new EMU and DMU vehicles, assuming similar annual mileages, at February 2013 price levels'. Capital lease GBP 0.97 is a separate line. At 150,000 miles a car-year GBP 66,000 nominal = 615 in 1900 money (general index 10,725); at 100,000 miles GBP 44,000 = 410.

name_or_item: RDG Long Term Passenger Rolling Stock Strategy, new DMU
scope: as the EMU row; capital lease GBP 1.43 separate
notes: MEASURED. 1.82 times the EMU rate. At 150,000 miles GBP 120,000 = 1,119 in 1900 money; at 100,000 miles GBP 80,000 = 746.

name_or_item: RDG new EMU converted at 150,000 miles a car-year
scope: as the per-mile row
source_ref: Computed: 0.44 x 150,000; deflated at general index 10,725
notes: DERIVED. 615 in 1900 money. 150,000 miles is report 43's assumption, not the RDG's; the RDG prints no annual mileage.

name_or_item: RDG new EMU converted at 100,000 miles a car-year
scope: as the per-mile row
source_ref: Computed: 0.44 x 100,000; deflated at general index 10,725
notes: DERIVED. 410 in 1900 money. 100,000 miles is close to the 95,775 miles implied by the ORR medians (136,000 / 1.42).

name_or_item: Serpell Report, total vehicle maintenance, 1982
scope: day-to-day, light, intermediate and general repairs; all vehicle types
source_ref: Railway Finances (1983), para 6.44; via research-pricing-report-43.md row 14

scope: as the total
source_ref: Computed: 473m / 50,000 x 1.75; deflated at general index 3,483

name_or_item: Class 365 C6X overhaul per car, Eversholt and Railcare
scope: C6X overhaul only; above the solebar
notes: MEASURED. GBP 13m for 40 four-car units = 160 cars. 781 in 1900 money at the general index 10,409. The only measured pure C6X price found.

name_or_item: Class 365 C6X plus C4 plus PRM refresh per car, Eversholt and Bombardier
scope: C6X above the solebar, C4 below it including bogies to Crewe, interior refresh, PRM works
source_ref: Eversholt Rail, 20 November 2013; https://eversholtrail.co.uk/news/eversholt-rail-awards-contract-to-bombardier-transportation/ (the GBP 31m figure was announced on 5 July 2013: https://eversholtrail.co.uk/news/makeover-announced-for-first-capital-connect-class-365-great-northern-route-trains/)
notes: MEASURED. 'In excess of GBP 30m' for 40 four-car units; the July 2013 announcement said GBP 31m. 1,748 in 1900 money. Not a C6 price: 2.31 times the C6X-only contract. RAIL 741 (5 February 2014) confirms the C6X above the solebar and the C4 below it.

name_or_item: Inverness Class 158 C6+ refurbishment per car, Transport Scotland
scope: C6+ classified overhaul plus full interior refit, seating, lighting, toilets and PRM
notes: MEASURED. GBP 9m for 25 two-car units = 50 cars, 2007-08. 1,954 in 1900 money at the general index 9,212. Refurbishment-inclusive: 3.3 times a routine C6 event at that date.
